## Purpose And Behavior

Explain the bounded change and link the issue it addresses. Use a closing keyword only when all acceptance conditions have evidence; pilot preparation alone does not close a school-testing issue.

## Verification

Record checks actually completed and any remaining pilot work. Build-producing changes must include the actual identifier and evidence from [Build Identity](../docs/BUILD_IDENTITY.md). Keep teacher keys, student data, and private source references out of this public description.
